inventory.noMovementsBody: Every stock change appears here — receipts, sales and adjustments alike.
inventory.intro_receive: Incoming quantity with a batch, expiry date and unit cost. That cost is what profit is later calculated against.
inventory.intro_adjust: Correct the balance after a physical count. The difference is recorded as a movement with its reason — the old figure is never overwritten.
inventory.intro_transfer: Move a quantity between locations — two linked movements, so nothing is lost in between.
inventory.intro_damage: Remove damaged stock from what is available. It appears in finance as a loss.
inventory.unstockedCount: {{count}} products are absent from the storefront because none is available.
inventory.allStockedBody: No active product is without stock — the whole catalogue is sellable.
inventory.askAnAdmin: Ask a system administrator to set it — you do not have permission to edit storage locations.
inventory.noLocations: No active stock location — create one under Reference settings → Storage locations before recording any movement.
inventory.noDefaultLocation: No active default location — choose one explicitly, or set a default under Reference settings → Storage locations.
inventory.unitCostHint: Required — without it profit cannot be calculated later
inventory.expiresAtHint: Stock is issued by nearest expiry, not by oldest receipt
inventory.adjustNote: An adjustment never erases the old figure: it is recorded as a movement with its reason, and the log stays complete.
inventory.damageNote: The quantity leaves availability immediately and does not return. Correct it with an upward adjustment, not by deleting this movement.
inventory.pickerPlaceholder: Search by name or SKU, or scan a barcode…
inventory.noCountsBody: Pick a location and start a count — balances are snapshotted immediately.
inventory.countHint: Enter what you actually counted. The expected figure appears after entry to prevent copying it.
inventory.noReservationsBody: Reservations subtract from available stock — none means all stock is available.

branding.socialHint: Leave a field empty and its link disappears from the store footer.

branding.assetHint_icon: Square — for the app and sharing.
branding.assetHint_og_image: Shown when the site link is shared — 1200×630.

branding.assetHint_hero_image_dark: Shown in dark mode. If left empty the light-theme image is used.

insights.bulkHint: Each name gets a unique random code with the same terms as the template. All or none are created.
insights.prefixHint: Latin letters, digits and a dash, e.g. SARA-
insights.bulkResultHint: Copy the list now and hand each person their code. The codes stay visible in the coupon list afterwards.

loyalty.redemptionPaused: Redemption is paused for now — earning continues.
loyalty.couponReady: Your coupon is ready — use it at checkout
loyalty.couponPersonal: The code is tied to your account and works for no one else.
loyalty.referralHint: You earn {{referrer}} points, your friend earns {{referee}}
loyalty.referralCondition: Paid on the referred friend's first completed order of at least {{amount}}.
loyalty.shareText: Use my code {{code}} when you sign up and get welcome points.
loyalty.noHistoryBody: Your first completed order earns your first points.
loyalty.unavailable: The points programme is not available on your account
loyalty.unavailableBody: It may target another group, or be switched off right now.
loyalty.programStoppedBody: Your balance is kept as is; redemption returns when it is switched back on.
loyalty.codeHint: Lowercase letters and dashes — cannot be changed later
loyalty.createdOff: Created switched off — review the rules, then switch it on
loyalty.createdOffNotice: New programmes are created switched off: set the rules first, then turn it on.
loyalty.confirmDeleteProgram: Delete this programme? Refused if any points were awarded from it.
loyalty.confirmDeleteTier: Delete this tier? Everyone who reached it drops to the tier below at once.
loyalty.noTiers: No tiers — one rate for everyone
loyalty.confirmExpire: Drop every point past its expiry date now?
loyalty.adjustHint: Add or deduct points with no order behind them — recorded with your name and reason.
loyalty.findCustomerHint: Name, customer number, email, or phone
loyalty.notCoveredBody: No loyalty programme covers this customer — the adjustment is refused until targeting is widened.
loyalty.adjustReasonHint: Required — shown on the customer statement and in the audit log
loyalty.deductionCapped: Balance is only {{balance}} — the available amount is taken; customers never owe points.

access.matrixHint: Who sees what — computed by the evaluation engine itself, not read off fields.
access.legend: First cell before verification, second after · ✓ allowed · ✕ denied
access.noPoliciesBody: Add one from the Policies tab and it appears here.

mail.deleteAccountBody: The account “{{name}}” and its settings will be removed. Are you sure?
mail.imapOk: IMAP connection OK — “{{folder}}”: {{count}} messages, last UID {{uid}}, {{pending}} waiting to be pulled
mail.inboxEmptyBody: If you are expecting messages: open the “Accounts” tab and press “Test IMAP”, then make sure the pull job is scheduled on the server.
mail.noInboundAccount: No active inbound mailbox — customer replies will not reach this screen until an account with direction “Inbound” or “Outbound & inbound” and IMAP settings is added.
mail.previewEmailFrame: Email preview as the customer will see it
mail.previewEmailTitle: As the customer will see it
mail.replyToMissing: No “Reply-to” address: customers who reply to mail from this account will write to {{address}}, which nobody may read.
mail.verifySkipped: Receive-only account — there is no SMTP to test. Use “Test IMAP”.
mail.htmlHidden: This message contains HTML - only plain text is shown, as protection against malicious scripts.
mail.imapUsernameHint: Leave empty to reuse the sending username
mail.isDefaultHint: The end of every unassigned route
mail.isMarketingHint: Never carries account or security mail - blocklists hit it first
mail.noDefaultAccount: No active default account - mail falls back to environment settings or is printed to the server log.
mail.noReplyToAuto: Automatic message: replying is blocked to prevent mail loops.
mail.pageHint: Sending and receiving accounts, what each is responsible for, message templates, and the log of what went out and came in.
mail.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current one
mail.replyToHint: An address a human reads - replies to noreply go nowhere
mail.routingHint: Assigned and fell-through-to-default give the same account today and differ tomorrow: changing the default moves everything not explicitly assigned.
mail.subject: Subject

shipping.locationHint: Where the shipment is now — shown to the customer in the tracking log
shipping.trackHint: Enter the shipment number — no sign-in needed
shipping.notFoundHint: Check the number as it appeared in your order confirmation
shipping.setupHint: Zones, methods and rates — what the customer pays for delivery, computed from here on every order.
shipping.freeShippingHint: Ship free automatically once the products total reaches an amount you choose. Off by default.
shipping.freeShippingSwitchHint: Home delivery only — branch pickup is always free.
shipping.freeShippingAmountHint: Counted on the products total after discounts and coupons, before tax and shipping.
shipping.freeShippingAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero to turn free shipping on.
shipping.freeShippingPreview: Orders of {{amount}} or more ship free
shipping.freeShippingPreviewOff: Free shipping is off — every order pays its zone's rate.
shipping.freeShippingPreviewIdle: Enter an amount to preview the sentence customers will see.
shipping.freeShippingMethodsNote: Choose which methods are excluded from the Methods tab.
shipping.eligibleForFreeHint: When the free-shipping condition is met this method ships free. Turn it off for a method such as express that should always be paid.
shipping.governoratesHint: Picked from the list — the match is literal, and a governorate held by another zone shows that zone's code.
shipping.isDefaultZoneHint: Its fees answer for any governorate not assigned to a zone.
shipping.defaultZoneNote: The default zone covers every unassigned governorate — do not name governorates on it, or the same one sits in two places at two fees.
shipping.noDefaultZoneWarning: There is no default zone — any unassigned governorate gets no shipping option, and its order cannot complete.
shipping.unassignedWarning: {{count}} governorate(s) with no zone — quoted at the default zone's fees ({{zone}}).
shipping.descriptionHint: The customer reads it under the option at checkout.
shipping.isPickupHint: No shipping fee and no address.
shipping.isPickupNote: The option is quoted at zero whatever its rate says, and no address is asked for. Flipping it on a method already in use changes how the orders carrying it behave.
shipping.pickupRateNote: This is a branch-pickup method — it is quoted at zero whatever you type here.
shipping.freeAboveHint: Empty = no free shipping for this zone. The threshold is per zone, because delivery genuinely costs a different amount in each.
shipping.rateActiveHint: Disabling it removes the option from checkout immediately.
shipping.noZonesBody: Start with a default zone — without one, no unassigned governorate gets a shipping option.
shipping.noMethodsBody: A method with no rate never reaches the customer — the rate is what prices it in each zone.
shipping.noRatesBody: A rate ties a zone to a method and sets its fee — without one the customer is shown nothing.

imports.title: Bulk product import
imports.subtitle: Add or update thousands of items from one Excel file
imports.step1Body: Built from your catalogue as it stands — your categories and brands, with dropdowns inside the cells.
imports.limits: Up to {{rows}} rows per sheet · up to {{mb}} MB per file
imports.step2Body: Choose what the file should do: create only, update only, or both.
imports.duplicateFile: This exact file was imported on {{date}} and created {{count}} items. Re-importing is allowed — check the mode first.
imports.step3Body: The dry run reads every row and writes nothing. One error stops the whole file — fix it and upload again.
imports.awaitingFile: Upload a file to start the check.
imports.readyToRun: The file is clean — {{create}} items will be created and {{update}} updated.
imports.draftNote: Products arrive inactive — nothing appears in the store until you publish.
imports.rejected: {{count}} rows carry an error that blocks the import.
imports.step4Body: Once you have looked at the result, activating everything is one press.
imports.notRunYet: The import has not run yet.
imports.publishExplain: Import publishes nothing on its own. Review the products first if you like, then activate them all together.
imports.noCategories: No categories exist — a category is mandatory on every product, so every row would be rejected.
imports.busyNotice: An import is running on this page — wait for it, or stop it, before opening another.
imports.historySubtitle: Every import — and the way back into a job left half-finished

exports.title: Data export
exports.subtitle: Take the rows out to Excel — to analyse, or to edit and upload back
exports.limits: Up to {{rows}} rows per file. If the result is larger the system tells you the count so you can narrow the filter.
exports.roundTripHint: Comes out with the import template's columns — edit it and upload on the import screen
exports.includeContact: Include email, phone and address — this is a contact-data export, and it is recorded against your name in the audit log
exports.noneAvailable: No datasets are available to your account
exports.noneAvailableBody: Each dataset needs its own domain permission. Ask your system administrator.
